description:
Part of epic ag-o6z; read it first. Needs ag-o6z.2 (runs without telemetry).

## Goal

Each run records its jobs and steps with their conclusions, so a person can see e.g. that "Audit with Claude" and "Open a PR with the fixes" were `skipped` (the gate skipped the run), or which step failed.

## Decision

One API call when the run completes, not a `workflow_job` subscription (epic, decision 4). The App already has Actions: read.

## Where the code is

- internal/core/model.go: Backend interface, Run. internal/github/github.go: Backend (go-github client per installation, see GetRunAttempt). internal/core/service_test.go: fakeBackend to extend.
- internal/core/worker.go: ApplyLifecycle, Reconcile.
- internal/web/templates.html `run`; internal/web/server.go.

## What to build

1. Backend.ListJobs(ctx, deployment, runID, attempt) → `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs` (go-github: Actions.ListWorkflowJobsAttempt), all pages (per_page 100).
2. Run gets `Jobs []Job` (omitempty): Job {ID, Name, Status, Conclusion, StartedAt, CompletedAt, RunnerName, URL (html_url), Steps []Step}; Step {Number, Name, Status, Conclusion, StartedAt, CompletedAt}. Caps: 50 jobs, 100 steps per job, names cut to 200 chars. Pointers or omitempty for missing times.
3. When a run first becomes terminal, fetch jobs outside the DB transaction, then save them in a short transaction. If the call fails, leave Jobs missing; Reconcile retries runs that finished in the last 24 h with no Jobs. Do it once: a run with Jobs is not fetched again.
4. Run page: "Jobs and steps" section, one table per job (name, conclusion badge, start/end), steps in order. Steps numbers may jump (post steps such as 28, 29); show them as given. A reusable workflow's job is named like "audit / audit".

## Docs

docs/10-design.md Data (runs) and Flow; docs/20-routes.md `GET /runs/{id}`; glossary Configuration/Run if useful.

## How to check

- Unit test conversion from go-github jobs; DB test that a completed run gets jobs once and that a failed call is retried by Reconcile.
- After deploy: xpmatteo/rpg-interpreter run 38696780798-like skip shows the gate step success and the rest skipped.

## Open questions for Matt

None known.
title: Record the jobs and steps of each run when it completes
